system.description: Lesser Abyssals might steady themselves with Essence for a time, only to fall flat on their faces at a key moment in combat when they cannot afford to waste a Charm activation on the effect. With this Charm, however, activating Raiton's Nimble Perch no longer counts as Charm use. More importantly, whenever the Abyssal has Raiton's Nimble Perch active, she can spend one mote to negate all damage from falling and automatically succeeds on any attempt to arrest a fall by grabbing onto something (unless there is absolutely nothing available to grab). New Solar Charm: Perfect Poise Stance (Prerequisites: Graceful Crane Stance; Exalted, p. 222). This Charm functions identically to Effortless Unnatural Grace.
